unit: Five session cases with each of two backends at each revision; the same ten cases were read at both revisions.
finding: Uniform rotation and distributing both keys first preserve sessions at head. Old-only verification fails in Django auth, Django signing and ItsDangerous. Kubernetes documents rolling updates as the default, but no percentage of Django deployments with incompatible keys is established.
